description: Configure the existing Freestyle job named 'legacy-inventory-sync' to poll SCM for changes. Set the polling schedule to run every 15 minutes between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM on weekdays (Monday through Friday). Additionally, configure a Quiet Period of 120 seconds to wait for further commits before building. You are already logged in as admin. If prompted, use Username: admin, Password: Admin123!
